name: work-smarter
description: Evidence-grounded research and interactive teaching, reliable instruction design, and durable personal-context indexing with authoritative record routing.

interface.shortDescription: Research, teaching, skill design, and context
interface.longDescription: Investigate substantive questions with current, high-quality evidence and explicit uncertainty. Learn concepts through adaptive, source-grounded dialogue. Design, refine, and test prompts, instructions, skills, plugins, contracts, evaluations, and working-memory systems. Maintain a durable personal-context index that routes topics to their authoritative records.
defaultPrompt: Design and test a reliable skill or plugin for this workflow.
Review these instructions for ambiguity, duplication, and misplaced content.
Research the current conventions, then improve this instruction package.
Teach me this concept interactively and check that I understand it.
Remember this reusable preference and keep its canonical source easy to find.
